radiusSource: Radius 5.23 (+1.21/-0.85) solar radii and mass 12.20 (+1.9/-1.7) solar masses from Habibi et al. (2017, ApJ 847, 120; arXiv:1708.06353), Table 3, model-atmosphere fit to SINFONI spectra (Teff 27288 K, B0-B3), at 695,700 km per solar radius and the JPL solar GM.
orbitalPeriodSource: Gillessen et al. (2017, ApJ 837, 30; VizieR J/ApJ/837/30), table3: P = 77.00 +/- 1.00 yr of 365.25 d.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius in the shared neutral gray. No image, color, map or oblateness of S4 is measured; only its size, mass and orbit are.

effectiveTemperatureSource: Habibi et al. (2017), ApJ 847, 120, Table 3: Teff 27,288 K (https://arxiv.org/abs/1708.06353)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/s4.json, log10(GM/R^2) in cgs, rounded to two decimals
massSource: 12.2 solar masses: Habibi et al. (2017), ApJ 847, 120, Table 3: 12.20 (+1.9/-1.7) solar masses (https://arxiv.org/abs/1708.06353).
